Siddharth,
I finally went home last weekend, first time in four years. Took a day off from the Pune office, got the overnight train, and walked straight to our old ground behind Sector 6.
It's a parking lot now. Painted lines where our pitch was. The paan shop where we split one cold drink is a phone repair counter. Even the neem tree we used as a stump is gone.

Mummy is fine, older, slower on the stairs. We had dinner and it was good, but not the thing I came for.
When you're back from Dubai, let's meet anyway. Some parking lot.
Manoj
